objective: Distinguish structural causes of the exact 4x5-flat versus 5x4-obstructed cocycle contrast without solved W/D/L input.
parent_clue: 4x5 and 5x4 share 20 occupied-cell ranks but differ sharply in nonzero fundamental-cycle syndromes.
represented_insufficiency: The current packet proves the contrast but does not isolate whether frontier blocking, final-cap parity closure, geometry orientation, or their interaction causes it.
observation_leverage: A 2x2 ablation over the two already represented producer closures changes one exact structural ingredient at a time on both transposed geometries.

excluded: solved W/D/L as structural producer input
open: unmodeled structural transition features revealed by open observations

open_observation_channel: Preserve every returned summary field and transition/cycle signature distribution; unexpected distinctions reopen the working model.
adaptive_evidence_firewall: Any dimension selected from EW-001 observations requires a fresh follow-up control before confirmatory use.
prohibited_information_sources: preloaded W/D/L labels in structural producer

valuation.objective: maximum discrimination among the currently live geometry/closure explanations
valuation.initial_choice_reason: 2x2 paired ablation reuses existing exact producer dimensions and is cheaper/more interpretable than opening new closure dimensions or board sizes.
